integration.npc_layout: res://visuals/npc_layout.gd: DATA maps every quest NPC name to two64x96 rects and absolute foot anchors; BASES has16 original designs plus16 outfit-color variants, one unique sprite pair per NPC; all face left.
integration.quest_drop_rule: For collect quests, the named item is a quest-specific drop from target. It need not be a normal loot-table item. Award or increment it only while that quest is active.
integration.prerequisites: For each quest with a next value, require completion before accepting its successor; start only quests not referenced by next.
integration.nearby_starting_ground: Willowbridge quests use its directly connected Farmeadow approach. Targets in regional routes can have a lower placed level than their default roster level.
integration.scope: Art and content only; Claude wires the runtime systems.
integration.climb_layout: res://visuals/climb_layout.gd: DATA is biome -> six Rect2 regions; rope_mid=16x64 and ladder_mid=32x64; repeat vertically without scaling. Top/bottom are16px tall.
integration.climb_bodies: res://visuals/body_layout.gd: CLIMB[class] supplies a separate texture, skin_mask and two anchored frames each for climb_rope/climb_ladder. Anchors and heads are absolute source-pixel coordinates; hands are relative offsets from feet, matching the existing body format. Optional custom_texture/custom_skin_mask are bald back-view companions, for fully replacing hair during climbing; default texture keeps each original class look.
integration.character_looks: res://visuals/custom_body_layout.gd: opt-in neutral bald companions preserve original poses and clothing. Its heads array matches body_layout.HEAD_ANCHORS. Draw each hair/face region at its per-view anchor, using HAIR_SCALE/FACE_SCALE before the usual body scale. Reuse the back/rear_side hair views while climbing.
integration.skin_tint: custom and climb skin_mask textures match their entire source sheets. Sample the red channel to restrict tinting to neutral exposed skin; multiply-tint face plates with the same skin color and tint hair separately. Skin masks leave clothing colors alone.
integration.pet_layout: res://visuals/pet_layout.gd: rects/anchors, idle[0,1], walk[2,3,4,5], jump[6]; all48x48, facing right.
integration.levelup_layout: res://visuals/levelup_layout.gd: LEVEL_UP has six256x256 frames at10fps, ground anchors; SKILL_LEARNED has four frames at10fps with centered anchors and smaller blue sparkles; neither loops.
integration.writing_scope: Four linked quests per town,128 total. next identifies a successor; require its predecessor completed before offering it. The final step of every chain gives usable universal gear.
integration.quest_map: Each quest includes target_map, the actual local hunting map ID; dialogue uses its displayed map name rather than an internal route ID.
